section_summary.extract_value: This Discussion section presents findings from a single study examining predictors of cosmetic surgery consideration among female undergraduates. Body appreciation emerged as the strongest predictor, along with media influence (SATAQ-3 subscales) and weight status, collectively explaining 47.1% of variance. The authors acknowledge limitations including the restricted sample (undergraduate women with constricted BMI and age ranges) and suggest future research should include additional psychological variables and representative community samples.
